text:
sam: Anyone else seeing terraform apply hang in staging after we rotated provider credentials this morning? It gets stuck on 'resolving provider plugins' then nothing for minutes. :thinking:

jordan: saw one run. CI job was stuck at 'Acquiring state lock' then timed out. Did we rotate in vault or the IAM creds?

sam: Ops rotated the AWS keys in Secrets Manager and we pushed a new provider creds ref. Noticed some runs started failing afterwards.

pat: Can you paste the tail of the terraform run log? usually shows which provider or step it's stuck on.

sam: here's the tail: ```
2026-03-16T09:12:02Z [INFO]  plugin: starting plugin process...
2026-03-16T09:12:03Z [DEBUG] terraform: checking provider registry for provider["registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws"]
2026-03-16T09:12:03Z [WARN]  plugin: provider registry responding slowly
2026-03-16T09:12:05Z [ERROR] error downloading providers: provider registry request timed out
```

alex: looks like provider download/verification failing. If the CI VPC has no egress or registry rate-limited, that can block. Did the nodes lose egress during the rotate?

jordan: also saw an ops-bot message about credentials rotated at 09:10. ops-bot: "aws-creds rotation completed for staging - secret:ssm/staging/aws-creds - rotated by ops"

pat: Quick checks: 1) can you run `terraform init -upgrade -get-plugins=false` to avoid remote downloads? 2) check `terraform providers` and `terraform providers lock`?

sam: tried `terraform init -reconfigure` — it picks up the new creds but still hangs on provider verification step. Running with `TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR` set shows it's attempting to download but failing with TLS timeouts.

terraform-runner: CI run 4567 aborted: provider download failed after 5 attempts. See logs at https://ci.internal/runs/4567 :warning:

pat: if the provider binary is already in the cache we can `get-plugins=false` then point to the local plugin cache. Alternatively run `terraform providers lock` on a machine with egress and check in the .terraform.lock.hcl to repo so CI doesn't need to talk to registry.

alex: other workaround: use `terraform state replace-provider` if the provider namespace changed during rotation (rare). But first confirm it's only network/timeouts not provider mismatch.

sam: one more wrinkle — after I manually unlocked the state (it was still locked from previous failed run) an apply started but then errored with: "provider configuration not present for registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws" followed by many resources marked as tainted.

jordan: that suggests the provider block didn't get configured (maybe credentials env vars missing for that runner). Did you export AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE or AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID in the agent?

sam: env vars are present. I can run `aws sts get-caller-identity` from the runner and it works. So creds ok.

pat: Steps I'd try: 1) run `terraform providers` locally to confirm mapping, 2) `terraform init -get-plugins=false` to use cached plugins, 3) regenerate `.terraform.lock.hcl` from dev machine and pin it in CI, 4) confirm CI runner egress and DNS to registry.

alex: also check the provider mirror config if any: `provider_installation` in CLI config can force local mirror and avoid remote.

sam: created a short issue and put logs: https://tracker.internal/RED-789. I'll try the lockfile pinning approach and re-run the CI. Assigning to me, will update here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident note: creds-rotation-staging completed at 2026-03-16T09:10Z. Monitoring for related CI failures.

jordan: if you get a repro, ping me and I'll help with the state unlock/verify — want to avoid double-apply from manual retries.

sam: thanks — repro steps in the ticket. If locking keeps the apply hung we should consider adding a preflight check to ensure provider registry reachable before acquiring lock.

pat: good call. We have a small helper script in infra/ci that can curl registry. I'll open a PR to gate applies.

sam: updating ticket with temp mitigation: pin .terraform.lock.hcl + run `terraform init -get-plugins=false` in CI until registry egress confirmed. Will update when CI green.

jordan: ack. keep us posted. :eyes:
